2023 Jetour Traveller 2.0T 4WD Conquest Pro Brief Specs

Basic Parameters

• Model: 2023 Jetour Traveller, 5-door 5-seat off-road SUV

• Powertrain: 2.0T turbo petrol inline-4, 254hp / 390N·m, 8-speed AT, AWD timely four-wheel drive

• Off-road gear: Central & rear differential locks, 6 driving modes, 700mm wading depth

• Dimension: 478520061880mm, wheelbase 2800mm, ground clearance 220mm

• Fuel: 92# gasoline, WLTC fuel consumption 9.58L/100km

• Max speed: 180km/h, fuel tank 70L

Exterior

• Square LED headlights + LED daytime running lights

• 19-inch off-road alloy wheels (255/60 R19)

• Heavy-duty roof rails, heated power side mirrors

• Front/rear parking sensors, 360° panoramic camera + transparent chassis view

• Electric suction tailgate, rear windshield defroster

Interior & Comfort

• Faux leather seats, front heating, ventilation & massage

• Electric adjustable driver & co-pilot seats with memory

• Keyless entry & one-button start

• Multi-function steering wheel, adaptive cruise control (L2 assist)

• Dual-zone automatic air conditioning

• Large central touch screen, 8155 chip intelligent vehicle system, multi-color ambient lights

Safety

• 6 airbags (front, side & curtain)

• ABS, EBD, ESP, hill-start assist, auto hold

• Full tire pressure monitoring

• Forward collision warning, active brake, lane departure keep assist

• Traffic sign recognition, fatigue driving reminder, door open warning

• ISOFIX child seat interface
